actions.operation: Expand $(z+i)^4$ and rewrite the given equation exactly as $(z+i)^4=1+i$.
Write $1+i$ in polar form; its fourth roots give a translated square with circumradius $R=|1+i|^{1/4}$.
Use the square formula $A=2R^2=2|1+i|^{1/2}$, combine the prime powers, reduce the exponent, and evaluate the requested $a+b+p$.
